description: Insulation contractor in Alameda, CA for the island's older Victorians and wartime tracts, served from our San Leandro base 7 miles away. Book an inspection.
intro: East Bay Insulation serves Alameda from our San Leandro base, 7 miles to the east. The island's older Victorians and wartime-era tracts are the two housing types we see most there, and each needs its own approach to insulation.

paragraphs: Alameda's older Victorians tend to have unfinished attics, open wall cavities and gaps where air moves freely. The wartime tracts are simpler buildings where attic and crawl space insulation is often thin or worn out.
A free inspection shows what your home has today and what it would take to bring it up to current standards, with a written estimate before any work starts.

sections.h2: The calls we get in Alameda
bullets: Attic insulation and air sealing in older homes
Crawl space encapsulation and vapor barriers
Wall insulation where cavities are open

faqs.q: How far is Alameda from your base?
faqs.a: About 7 miles west of San Leandro, so inspections and follow-up visits are quick to schedule.

faqs.q: Do you work on older Victorians?
faqs.a: Yes. We plan around older framing and finished spaces, and we write the estimate only after seeing the attic, walls and crawl space.

faqs.q: How soon can you start in Alameda?
faqs.a: Most Alameda jobs start within one to two weeks of the inspection. The estimate is free and there is no obligation to proceed.
